data.content: Added seven focused durable-outbox failure-path tests plus database error display/source coverage in commit 598123be. Tests cover idempotent receipts and quarantine, pending credential rotation rejection, exact proposal ownership, mixed/stale remote OID rejection, empty publication, malformed writer scope, and invalid prepared inputs. Thirteen outbox tests and three event-error tests pass; full make sanity passes at 95.18% overall coverage with no threshold reduction. Commit and Sneka attribution are published to PR #105.
